lines.text: It's 3 AM, you're almost asleep, and suddenly — that cringey thing you said in 2019.
Why does your brain only torture you at night?
Because all day it's busy — people, your phone, noise.
But at 3 AM there's nothing left to focus on, so the default mode network wakes up.
It's the part of your brain that replays your own life.
And it doesn't replay the wins — it hunts your mistakes.
That's negativity bias, your brain trying to stop you repeating them.
It fires the same circuits as physical pain, so it literally hurts.
So when 2019 shows up tonight, remember — it's not a sign.
It's just a buggy security check you can switch off.
